carrick.sacked: Thursday 12 November 2026 (Al Jazeera dates it 12 November; ESPN says 'Thursday')
carrick.games: 15 games into the contract (ESPN); three wins from 15 matches across all competitions (Al Jazeera)
carrick.league: one win and eight points from 10 Premier League games (Al Jazeera)
carrick.disagreement: Wikipedia's season page says 3 wins from 17 matches at dismissal. The narration uses the Al Jazeera and ESPN 15-game figure only.

pochettino.announced: 13 November 2026 (Al Jazeera and France 24 are dated 13 November)
pochettino.contract: two-and-a-half years, through the end of the 2028/29 season (France 24); ESPN also says 2.5-year contract
pochettino.left: United States men's national team head coach
pochettino.start: ESPN says he begins work at Carrington on Wednesday and takes charge at Liverpool on November 22; Wikipedia says appointed from 18 November
pochettino.compensation: ESPN: a $10 million (£7.5m) release clause triggered by United. France 24: US Soccer reportedly set to receive around $10 million in compensation.
pochettino.quote: Not too many opportunities can happen in your career with a side like Manchester United. That is difficult to turn down when it arrives. (France 24)
pochettino.only_candidate: ESPN: he was the only candidate spoken to directly

worst_start.al_jazeera: their worst start to a league campaign in 40 years
worst_start.france24: made their worst start to a domestic campaign in 40 years

events.what: Leny Yoro sent off for denying a goal-scoring opportunity

liverpool_match.context: Pochettino's first match in charge; nine-game winless Premier League streak (ESPN)

united_season.winless: nine consecutive matches without a win for the first time since the 1988-89 season (Wikipedia, 8 November); ESPN also mentions a nine-game winless Premier League streak at the Liverpool game
united_season.record: 1 win, 5 draws, 5 losses in 11 league games; 14 scored, 23 conceded (Wikipedia table 23 November)

derived.gap_to_safety: Nottingham Forest and Sunderland have 9, United 8: one point

carrick_league_results.relegation_zone: United entered the relegation zone after nine games played for the first time ever in Premier League history (7 November)

pochettino_background.clubs: Southampton, Tottenham, Chelsea and Paris Saint-Germain, where he managed Messi, Mbappé and Neymar
pochettino_background.last_job: head coach of the United States men's national team
